  "workings": "To determine the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), we use the formula: WACC = (Debt * Cost of Debt + Equity * Cost of Equity) / (Debt + Equity). Given: Debt = Rwf25 million, Cost of Debt = 10%, Equity = Rwf20 million, Cost of Equity = 20%. WACC tax exempt: (25000000 * 0.10 + 20000000 * 0.20) / (25000000 + 20000000) = 0.144444 (= 14.4444%).
